scope: Extra headroom and cheaper 4-bit GPU experiment; existing public BF16 L4 stays selected unless a validated replacement is better.

targets.note: Comparison targets chosen from the existing 3-second capacity criterion, not a production SLA. Five-second results also reported.

prices.source: AWS Price List Query API / Linux Shared On-Demand

method: Same pinned Qwen base, same recorded Korean suite, Whisper turbo and Seoul Polly; fresh vehicle state, deterministic compact-v2 JSON planner. Resource samples at ~1 second, whole GPU and host. L4 uses an isolated loopback evaluation Node backend sharing the existing production model workers. A first attempt against the public backend hit its per-IP rate budget and is excluded from capacity measurements. No public rate protection was changed.
limitations: Not a sustained production SLA or real vehicle/microphone test.
NF4 on T4 uses FP16 compute because the T4 has no native BF16.
GPU memory used includes reservations, GPU busy percentage is not achieved FLOPS.
vLLM 0.32.0 installed image has no bitsandbytes backend; AWQ is a different 4-bit method and requires separate quality verification.
extraColocation: Compare one versus two identical Whisper workers on the same L4, least-active request routing, same single Qwen vLLM engine. Additional worker is a transient isolated process; model memory and compute remain shared. Four warmup requests ensure both ASR workers have served inference before timing.
holdoutRubricNote: Legacy holdout-weather expects denial, but the app now correctly answers real weather via its tool router. Raw scores keep this failure; the nine cabin-control holdouts are also reported separately. Do not attribute this rubric mismatch to LLM quality.

production.note: Existing public configuration retained. The second ASR worker and loopback evaluation backends were stopped after measuring; test GPU choice does not switch the public demo.
production.explanation: 현재 공유 데모: 서울 L4 + Qwen3.5-4B BF16 + vLLM + Whisper 1개. 도구 인자 스키마를 수정하고 공통 명령 30/31·첫 음성 중앙값 1.08초를 재확인했습니다. 저렴한 T4 + AWQ 4bit + vLLM도 같은 스키마에서 30/31·중앙값 1.01초를 기록했습니다. 단독 요청은 비슷하지만 동시 요청 4개의 첫 음성 p95는 L4 2.70초, T4 3.16초였습니다. 아래 추가 검증 표에서 비용과 부하를 함께 비교하세요.

conclusion: 이미 GPU를 공유해도 추가 활용 여지가 있었습니다. Whisper 2개는 높은 부하 처리량을 약 42% 늘렸지만 p95 3초 기준 개선은 약 6%였고 GPU 잔여는 최소 1.16GiB였습니다. 최종 동일 스키마 비교에서 T4 AWQ/vLLM은 공통 30/31, 첫 음성 중앙값 1.01초·p95 1.58초로 저빈도 대안이 됐습니다. T4 한 대의 가동비는 월 $472.31로 L4보다 약 35% 낮지만, p95 3초 이내 관측 처리량은 T4 1.255건/초, L4 1.832건/초였습니다. 같은 피크 부하에서 필요한 서버 수를 함께 계산해야 합니다. 현재 공유 데모는 L4를 유지합니다. 짧은 반복 시험이며 운영 SLA나 하드웨어 최대치는 아닙니다.

schemaCorrection.trigger: AWQ omitted the required temperature zone. The legacy generic action schema required only type, permitting invalid executor arguments.
schemaCorrection.change: Discriminated per-action schemas require the actual executor arguments and forbid irrelevant fields. Existing range guards/executor behavior remain unchanged.
schemaCorrection.comparison: Rerun both L4 BF16 and T4 AWQ with the same corrected output schema, same prompts, same recorded audio and 24 load requests per concurrency level. Before-fix reports are preserved.

testGpuRetention: Normal EC2 stop requested after all tests; latest observed state stopping. Root volume and completed compiler caches retained; EBS storage still billed. Existing L4 and original L40S sharing instances stay running.
